response.justification: Strong, experienced generalist software engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and some desktop/embedded-adjacent work, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this role. The position mandates native-level Japanese, which there is no evidence of (listed languages: English, Romanian, basic German). Primary expertise is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang web and platform development, with only brief C/C++ exposure (National Instruments, ~7 months, and a C++ bachelor project). There is no demonstrated experience with Linux kernel source analysis and modification, LAN-switch firmware, MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 networking, SNMP/NETCONF, or chip-vendor SDKs. The gap on the hard requirements is too large to be closed by general engineering strength.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, senior-level software engineering experience
Solid Linux, systems, and low-latency/high-throughput service background (DLang, microservices)
Demonstrated engineering rigor: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching and mentoring
concerns: No evidence of Japanese language ability (native-level is a hard requirement)
Minimal recent C/UNIX development; no Linux kernel modification experience
No embedded LAN-switch, networking protocol, or security-technology (MACsec, 802.1X) experience

key_factors.factor: Lacks embedded networking and security domain experience
